claims.quote: Type locality is 'Caño de Quiribana, near Caicara, Venezuela' and this species is currently considered to range throughout the upper Orinoco drainage in Venezuela and rio Negro drainage in Amazonian Brazil with the occasional specimen also having been recorded from the rio Madeira which enters the Amazon downstream from the mouth of the Negro on the opposite bank.

Type locality is 'Caño de Quiribana, near Caicara, Venezuela' and this species is currently considered to range throughout the upper Orinoco drainage in Venezuela and rio Negro drainage in Amazonian Brazil with the occasional specimen also having been recorded from the rio Madeira which enters the Amazon downstream from the mouth of the Negro on the opposite bank.
It may also occur in Colombia with at least one record existing from the Río Vichada and another from the Río Inírida, both tributaries of the Orinoco.
